decision.title: The regex engine: the whole F&O 4.0 dialect (packet )

body.p: . is met by growing the seed in place, behind the same src/regex_internal.h (compile, match at, find, find next), not by a rewrite: its parser, emitted program and backtracking machine already follow Saxon HE's design.

item.p: Syntax (F&O 4.0, section 6.1.3): category escapes \p{Lu} (no Cs, as the grammar), block escapes \p{IsX} by the Blocks.txt name without spaces plus the four renamed XSD 1.0 names (IsGreek, IsCombiningMarksforSymbols, IsCyrillicSupplementary, IsPrivateUse); unknown names are FORX0002 (6.1.7). \i \c are XML 1.0 fifth edition NameStartChar and NameChar. XSD 1.1 hyphens: a "-" that separates no range is a character ([a-d-b-c], QT4 re00056a). \b \B, (?=) (?!) (?<=) (?<!) and the (*positive_lookahead:...) spellings; (?<name>...), \k<name>. Assertions take no quantifier.

Lookaround without recursion: LOOK_START pushes an assertion entry on the backtrack stack; LOOK_END of a positive assertion drops the choices above it but keeps the slot-restoring entries (captures stay, and are undone if matching later backtracks past the assertion; first match wins, 6.1.8.3), of a negative one undoes them and fails; backtracking onto the entry fails a positive assertion and resumes a negative one after it. A lookbehind branch is fixed-length (6.1.8.5), so it starts with STEP_BACK n.

Case-blind matching (6.2): variants by fn:lower-case/upper-case through sxml_function_library_map_case (the tables of src/function_library_case.c, shared), plus 94 pairs those mappings do not reach (KELVIN SIGN, final sigma, ...), generated with the same code as the case tables. A literal becomes a class of its variants at compile time; a range checks the input's variants at match time; back-references compare codepoint by codepoint.

Names: the compiled regex keeps each group's name and whether it is in a lookahead (new sxml_regex_group_name, _find_named_group, _group_is_in_lookahead); while compiling, names live in a table that grows through the stack allocator like the group stack.

Tables (tools/generate-regex-tables.py, Unicode 16.0: UnicodeData, SpecialCasing, Blocks): 4,099 category runs packed in uint32_t (\d and \w now derive from them), 342 blocks, 94 pairs; about 25 KB of read-only data.
Not done: counted repetition is still expanded, so a{2147483647} is LIMIT_EXCEEDED (QT4 cbcl-matches-004, -038).
